title: 10 Best Genista Tinctoria Preparations

Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, ideal for quick absorption and targeted use. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized option for daily supplementation, while oils extracted from the plant can be used topically for skin conditions and muscle relief.
